title: CrimeLens
description: An end-to-end NLP-to-GNN pipeline for crime scene analysis. A production-grade spaCy NER/ingestion pipeline processes 100+ documents/second, converting free-text crime narratives into structured entity-event graphs; a 3-layer residual GCN classifies crime type across 8 categories at 92% test accuracy. Predictions surface through an interactive TypeScript dashboard with real-time graph visualization and GNNExplainer-style interpretability, optimized for sub-100ms inference.
